# Vendored dependencies

`LlamaFactory/` contains the source supplied with SimulTrain, including project-specific modifications. Its upstream project is [LlamaFactory](https://github.com/hiyouga/LlamaFactory), licensed under Apache-2.0. The license and source copyright notices are retained in that directory.

Local environment files, editor/agent configuration and repository-hosting automation are excluded from this copy. Training uses `LlamaFactory/src` and the bundled DeepSpeed examples. The upstream examples, assets and documentation remain available in the vendor directory.
